package.description: Section 508 requirements package for ART using WCAG-aligned references.
package.author: U.S. Access Board

criteria.title: Without Vision
criteria.desc: ICT must provide at least one mode of operation that does not require user vision.
criteria.failures: Critical workflows require visual-only cues with no non-visual equivalent.
criteria.fixes: Expose equivalent information and control through programmatic interfaces and assistive technologies.

criteria.title: With Limited Vision
criteria.desc: ICT must support users with limited vision, including contrast, zoom, and scalable text behaviors.
criteria.failures: Interfaces fail at high zoom or low-vision settings.
criteria.fixes: Preserve readability, layout integrity, and control operability at high zoom levels.

criteria.title: Without Perception of Color
criteria.desc: Color must not be the only visual means of conveying information.
criteria.failures: Status is conveyed by color alone.
criteria.fixes: Add text labels, patterns, icons, or equivalent non-color cues.

criteria.title: With Limited Manipulation
criteria.desc: ICT must support operation by users with limited fine motor control and reach.
criteria.failures: Controls require precise pointer movement or timing.
criteria.fixes: Provide keyboard operation, adequate target size, and alternatives to precision gestures.
